attacks.name: Panther Strike
steps: After this attack is resolved, this character gains |!power| equal to the |!damage| dealt.
|!wild| |*Bleed|: After this attack is resolved, the defender gains the |§bleed§Bleed| special condition.

attacks.name: Spirit Predator
steps: |!wild| |!hit| |*Finisher|: After this attack is resolved, this character may make a |*Panther Strike| attack. This character may reroll any number of its attack dice during that attack.

superPowers.name: Pounce
superPowers.body: This character is Thrown |!range_small|. It does not suffer |!damage| if it collides with another character or terrain feature. This superpower can be used only once per Turn.

superPowers.name: Insight of the Ancients
superPowers.body: When this character rolls dice while Interacting with an objective token, after the dice are rolled, it may use this superpower. This character may reroll any number of its dice, including |!failure| results.

superPowers.name: Stealth
superPowers.body: Characters must be within |!range| 3 of this character to target it with attacks.

superPowers.name: Superior Agility
superPowers.body: Enemy characters cannot modify attack dice when targeting this character with attacks.
